job: Verify one product-decision flow against inputs frozen before execution and publish its canonical backend-owned snapshot and result pair, or stop at the exact unavailability instead of manufacturing a verdict.
sideEffects: write the canonical snapshot.json and result.json under the routed backend Source at .worktrees/uat/<feature>/<flow>/
write the typed verification receipt and its evidence index under input.project.artifactRootRef
delete only fixture records carrying both is_uat=true and the exact frozen fixture namespace
forbiddenSideEffects: store a password, cookie, token, OTP, or any recoverable secret in the account record
ask the user to sign in, lend an account, or paste a credential
mutate the frozen snapshot, cases, or fixtures after execution begins
create the outcome under test during fixture preparation
repair product source or open a writer on a root cause
promote UI evidence over Behavior or UX evidence
write checkout-local UAT authority or a UAT root belonging to another backend route
stopConditions: the Control Panel cannot auto-provision the run-scoped account or complete broker authentication
the Browser lease is absent, expired, foreign to the mission, or bound to another principal
the declared runtime owner is not ready or its origin does not match the lease
the admitted blind visual PASS or final quality PASS is missing
any evidence lane is unavailable rather than contradicted
the canonical snapshot or result cannot be written and reparsed under the routed backend Source
a resume adds no admission, lease, evidence, or case delta
